action_summary: Falsifies two general claims the owner's framing rests on and measures what replaces them. (1) 'Generalisation is not solved; exact matches only' is false as stated: the shipped one-demonstration learner recovers 0.529 of the developers' changes on 12 merged pull requests with ZERO wrong changes, and two demonstrations recover 0.891 on the same 132 pairs. (2) 'Generalise better by widening the rule' is backwards: the learner's widest rung recovers 0.048 at precision 0.455 with 42 wrong changes. What is actually scarce is a check: on 42 real changed files it could not run anywhere (6 tasks no test module imports the file, 6 tasks need an uninstalled dependency) while a positive control proves the check machinery discriminates. Adds a measurement tool, a committed record and 13 tests; adds no capability, flips no family, claims no progress.

load_bearing_primary.open_obligation_ids_note: The first two are the zero-expected-discharge bindings: this PR moves no benchmark. The second two are the causal-path bindings: the blocker it removes (a wrong generalisation kept because no check could run) is the same blocker that holds the agentic coding and the professional-work family at or below their gates. No obligation is claimed discharged; scope_complete_discharge is false.

measured_effect: 132 ordered demonstration-to-target pairs over 12 merged pull requests, whole project trees. Recovered share of the developers' changes / precision / wrong changes made: literal 0.010 / 0.636 / 4; one demonstration 0.529 / 1.000 / 0; two demonstrations 0.891 / 1.000 / 0; widest rung first 0.048 / 0.455 / 42; widest rung gated by the file's own tests 0.000 / n-a / 0. Positive control on a project that ships a check: discriminates=True (accepts the project, accepts a correct edit, rejects a wrong edit that still compiles, rejects a broken file). On the real corpus the check could not run on any of 42 changed files: 6 tasks CHECK_NO_TEST_MODULE, 6 tasks CHECK_DEPENDENCY_MISSING. The check was unavailable on 132 of 132 pairs. Constructed counterfactual, labelled constructed: the same lesson repairs two sibling modules and breaks a third whose '<=' was required; with that file's own tests as the gate the edit is refused and the file stays correct. That table was under-determined at first: its demonstration's test pinned one of the two boundaries its own code stated, so three corrections were refused for the check's credit rather than the demonstration's. With the second boundary stated in the demonstration's own test, all three corrections are still refused and the count of attempts is printed (wrong_edits_tried 3 per file), so a refusal cannot be manufactured by trying fewer things. The corpus numbers did not move when this was fixed, because the corpus never used that construction. Also recorded: six defects in the measuring instrument itself, each caught before any number was trusted. 15 tests pass; unified model verifier 33/33; repo-integrity-guard 17 rules 0 violations.

comparison.RELIABILITY: Deterministic; the check is subprocess-isolated and restores the original file.
comparison.VERIFIABILITY: 13 tests pin every number, including the two limits that must not be silently fixed.
comparison.WALL_CLOCK: Two minutes per corpus run in this sandbox; no training, no model.
